notes: GMGN 1% per transaction is from https://docs.gmgn.ai/index/gmgn-fees-settings (checked 2026-11-10). It is not a pool fee.
On-chain 0.002–0.005 SOL and auto 0.006 SOL are GMGN recommendations, not a protocol minimum.
Wallet reserve 0.05 SOL is a GMGN recommendation from the limit-order failure page, not a forced network rule.
pool_fee_percentage from GeckoTerminal was null for the pools in this run. Null is not zero.
proposed_per_trade_loss_budget_usd and proposed_max_drawdown_frac are PROPOSED research controls, not a user-accepted risk limit.
Slippage basis points are a research fill assumption. They are not the GMGN UI slippage tolerance of 30–35%.

conservative_no_trade.label_zh: 保守預設：歷史可賣性與流動性未知，且池費未知，不開倉
conservative_no_trade.chain_cost_note: GMGN 文件建議無速度要求時鏈上合計約 0.002–0.005 SOL 的上緣。這是建議，不是協議最低費。
conservative_no_trade.slip_note: 研究用不利滑點 30bp。不是 GMGN 介面上 30–35% 的成交容忍上限。

exploratory_ohlcv_only.label_zh: 探索實驗：放寬 OHLCV 無法核實的安全閘；池費是假設值，不是完整安全策略
exploratory_ohlcv_only.chain_cost_note: GMGN 建議區間上緣 0.005 SOL，不是協議最低費。
exploratory_ohlcv_only.slip_note: 研究用不利滑點 30bp，不是 GMGN 容忍上限。
